text:
maria: quick follow-up on the compact-on-idle proposal and a new paged_migrate API i pushed as a strawman. goal: reduce long-term fragmentation without touching p99 for small-batch inferences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/1234

ajay: link works, thanks. curious — what are the visible failure modes if a migrate task stalls or IO backs up?

maria: good q. failure modes: (1) migrate backlog increases which can push IO latency, (2) we might hit host fallback and increase network hops, (3) if we race with pin/unpin we could waste work. proposal includes rate limiting + cancel token and a dry_run mode.

maria: api sketch:
```
// paged_migrate moves soft-resident pages between pools/nodes
paged_migrate({
  tenant_id: string,
  from_pool: PoolId,
  to_node: NodeId,
  max_io_bytes_per_s?: u64,
  deadline_ms?: u32,
  dry_run?: bool,
  cancel_token?: CancelToken,
  policy: "compact" | "shuffle" | "demote",
}) -> MigrationHandle
```

sasha: +1 on rate limit. other notes: make it idempotent, never migrate pinned pages, prefer async best-effort so it cannot block inference dispatch. also expose progress metric (bytes_migrated, pages_skipped_pinned).

tanya: we'll need telemetry hooks: histograms for migrate latency, counter for aborted_due_to_pinned_threshold, and a gauge for inflight_migrate_bytes. add e2e that simulates contention (pins + migrations) so we can catch regressions.

ajay: implementation thought: reuse the existing migrate worker queue but attach per-tenant "compact credits" so a noisy tenant can't starve others. i prototyped a limiter: 8GB/s -> reduces observed fragmentation by ~12% in our trace and p99 token latency rose by ~1ms at peak. numbers are in the PR description.

maria: nice. question re: cross-node NUMA: should we allow affinity hints? migrating across NUMA might be worse than demoting to host then re-prefetch. i added an `affinity` option that prefers same-numa or same-rack nodes, fallback to demote if no local capacity.

sasha: safety checks i want: if pinned_pages_ratio > 0.25 then abort early; and if migrate iteration increases pagefault_rate by >X% then roll back (or switch to demote-only). also require that the API never reclaims pages that are younger than a retain_age_ms threshold.

infra-bot: CI: paged_migrate_unit_tests passed (12 tests). deploy pipeline queued for branch compact-on-idle.

tanya: ok to add to next sprint? i'll own the e2e harness (will script pinned workload + background migrate). :+1:

ajay: i'll sketch the rate-limiter and cancellation flow. one question: should MigrationHandle expose a cancel() + status() or just return a token for the control plane?

maria: expose both cancel() and status(); status should include dry_run flag, bytes_examined, bytes_migrated, pages_skipped and a small reason field. also include a graceful_shutdown pathway so on teardown we snapshot progress to allow resume. i'll update the PR with these changes. thanks all :thumbsup:
